selection_rule: Reduced V1 keeps 48 evenly distributed stable logical IDs across the original 96 while assigning deliberately varied design families for maximum visual breadth.
canary_rule: Do not launch bulk Full Outfits until all three canaries pass source-art review, locked-body movement fit, alpha validation and duplicate-silhouette review.
bulk_rule: After canary pass, produce only the remaining approved V1 IDs; never auto-expand to all 96 without explicit user instruction.
